what: The exact response bodies of GET https://superspeedy.org/api/v1/cohorts (cohorts.json) and GET https://superspeedy.org/api/v1/plugin-impact (plugin-impact.json), as emitted by the superspeedy.org public build. Not hand-written: regenerate them rather than editing them.
superspeedy_org_branch: main (the deployed public-figures build; first generated from feature/public-figures-all-sample-sizes b2e7835, whose build code is identical)
built: 2026-10-21, Go 1.24.9, the branch's own publication build with its default options
source_rows: Synthetic installations (n = 1 to 24) for this plugin's regression-site cohort ecommerce / <100 products / <10 plugins / object cache enabled / mariadb, page types beyond the key pages (post category, single post, and the wp-admin dashboard as the administrator variant), plus cohorts it is not in, and plugin-isolation rows for woocommerce, redis-cache and akismet.
generator: Kept in the private plugin metadata (.docs/compare-fixtures/), because it imports the superspeedy.org build.
